about_the_game:
ULTIMATE AUTO-RPG: STARTER PACK adds 3 new playable races, 5 new special pets and a bundle of potions, keys and scrolls. By buying this DLC you are first and foremost showing your support for Ultimate Auto-RPG and future development but you also get a load of exclusive bonus content.

PLAYABLE RACES

  • Goblin
  • Fungi
  • Gnome

NEW PETS

  • Archi
  • Galli
  • Snail
  • Scorpion
  • Hyena

SCROLLS

  • 3x Blessed Scroll of Enchant Ring
  • 5x Blessed Scroll of Resurrection
  • 10x Blessed Scroll of Escape

KEYS

  • 5x Skeleton key
  • 5x Treasure key
  • 5x Guest room key
  • 2x Mythic key

POTIONS

  • 10x Potion of Supreme Learning (XP boost)
  • 10x Potion of Luck II (Item find)

GOBLINS
The wizards of the tower has always regarded the goblins to be great servants. They are ruthless in combat and easy to manipulate when paid in gold coins for their services. The most famous goblin is called Wolfgrin. He served the masters of the tower for hundreds of years. The soul magic has kept him alive. He is the eldest goblin alive and leader of the Wolfpack clan, the biggest of all the goblin factions. Wolfgrin made pact with a troll sorcerer that was locked up in the tower to enchant abyss crystals and apply a troll curse to hide from the soul of the tower. This is when the goblins started to build their fortress in the upper tower and the legend of the goblin stronghold began.

FUNGI
The mysterious fungi lived in harmony together with the druids in the magical forests of Aldora for thousands of years before the first age and the time of the great wizards of the tower. The legend tells a story about the forest god Korganos and the sacred seed of life. This glowing magical seed was enchanted with a very powerful healing aura that could restore life force to the creatures in the forest. The fungi and their leader Fungus protected and worshipped this great source of life. This granted them the gift of rejuvination.

GNOMES
The scepter order was founded by the elder council of gnome mages in the first age. The gnomes are born with powerful magic and they have a limitless thirst for knowledge and wisdom. The legends tell that the ancient builders of the tower was the first gnomes from the mysterious elven magic city of Aldera.
